index.title: CleanU · Safe, transparent macOS menu bar cleanup
index.description: CleanU is a macOS menu bar disk cleanup app. Read-only scans cover caches, temporary files, developer-tool caches, project artifacts, app leftovers, installers, archives, and large files. Review and confirm before cleanup. macOS 15+, with one universal DMG for Apple Silicon and Intel.
index.intro: Scan caches, temporary files, developer-tool caches, project artifacts, app leftovers, installers, archives, and large files. Results are grouped into cache cleanup, project cleanup, app leftovers, and storage analysis. Every item shows its path and size. Nothing is cleaned up until you confirm.
index.altReview: CleanU scan results ready for review
index.altSelected: CleanU scan results with items selected
index.featureIntro: One scan lists cleanable items and how much space each one occupies.
index.featureScanBody: One deep scan groups results into cache cleanup, project cleanup, app leftovers, and storage analysis.
index.featureReviewBody: Every item shows its full path and size, and can be selected individually.
index.safetyReadBody: Scanning reads only directories and file attributes. It never writes, moves, or deletes any files.
index.safetyConfirmBody: Candidates are cleaned only after you explicitly confirm. There is no automatic background cleanup.
index.safetyCheckBody: Candidates are checked again before cleanup. Any item whose path or size no longer matches is excluded.
index.safetyTrashBody: Confirmed files go to the Trash and can be put back.
index.safetyPermissionsBody: CleanU runs with the current user’s permissions and never asks for an administrator password. Unreadable paths do not appear in the results.
index.pricingIntro: Try it free before you buy
index.pricingUpdatesBody: All future version updates are free with a one-time purchase.
index.pricingDevices: Up to two Macs at a time
index.pricingDevicesBody: Use your license on up to two Macs you own at a time. Deactivate the old Mac before switching Macs.
index.faqStorage: How is this different from System Settings → General → Storage?
index.faqStorageBody: System Settings shows storage by category, so you can see how much space each category uses, but it offers limited options for cleaning individual items. CleanU lists eight sources (caches, temporary files, developer-tool caches, project artifacts, app leftovers, installers, archives, and large files) in one view, with a full path and size for every item. Items move to the Trash only after you select and confirm them.
index.faqAccess: Why does CleanU need Full Disk Access?
index.faqAccessBody: Without this permission, macOS limits access to some directories, so results may be incomplete and some sources may appear empty. With Full Disk Access, CleanU can read caches and artifacts in those locations. The permission is only used for reading. CleanU runs with your current user’s permissions and never needs an administrator password.
index.faqDeletion: Could CleanU accidentally remove files that are still in use?
index.faqDeletionBefore: Only items you select and confirm are cleaned. Candidates are checked again, and any path or size mismatch is excluded. Files move to the Trash rather than being permanently deleted, so you can put them back. If you remove project artifacts (for example,
index.faqDeletionAfter: ), you will need to reinstall the project’s dependencies before it can run again.
index.faqUpload: Will it upload my files or data?
index.faqUploadBody: No. Scanning, reviewing, and cleanup all happen on your Mac. Every item in the list corresponds to a real path on disk. Cleaned files go to the Trash.
index.pricingTrialBody: Use every feature for 30 days with no account required. To keep using CleanU after the trial, purchase and activate a license. We do not offer refunds for a change of mind or non-use.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy · CleanU
privacy.description: Learn how CleanU handles on-device file information, license requests, and website visits.
privacy.intro: This policy applies to the CleanU macOS app and website. It explains how local file information, licensing requests, and website visits are handled.
privacy.scopeBody: During a scan, CleanU reads directories, file paths, and file attributes on your Mac to identify candidates and calculate their sizes. Scanning, review, and cleanup happen locally; the app does not upload file contents, scan results, or cleanup history. CleanU does not require an account and does not include in-app advertising or analytics SDKs.
privacy.networkBody: When you check for updates, CleanU connects to retrieve version information; it does not upload scan results or cleanup history. The website stores your theme choice in your browser and does not use ads or third-party analytics. When you visit the website, check for updates, or make a purchase, the relevant services may receive routine connection information such as your IP address. See their privacy policies for details.
privacy.thirdPartyBody: Data processed by Dodo Payments, GitHub, and Cloudflare is subject to their privacy policies:
privacy.contactBodyBefore: For questions about this policy or data handling, contact us through the
privacy.changesBody: If the app’s data practices change, we will update the date and information on this page.
privacy.licenseBody: Dodo Payments handles payment and license emails. On first activation, CleanU sends the license key and a randomly generated installation ID. For later verification or deactivation, it sends the license key and the activation ID returned by Dodo Payments. It does not send scan results, file paths, or cleanup history.
privacy.keychainBody: Trial and license records are stored in your Mac’s Keychain and are not synced through iCloud. Reinstalling CleanU does not remove them. To free a license slot, deactivate the license in the app on that Mac and wait for confirmation.

Share only the email address used for the purchase, necessary order details, and a brief description of the issue. Never post license keys or payment details in public GitHub Issues.
